coverage_nominal_965.note: coverage of the nominal 96.5 % interval over defined datasets, guard ignored; reported apart from claim errors

rule_text: PASS (all-or-nothing) iff every acceptance null cell has one-sided 95 % Clopper-Pearson upper bound <= .0275 AND point rate <= .025; R = 100,000 in every configuration; any failure -> H1 estimation-only
